relevant_argument: Section1.7 constructs satellite K(alpha,beta;p,q) by mapping the second component meridian of a two-bridge link to a Seifert fiber of the torus-knot exterior. Section1.8 cuts that exterior along an essential annulus into two solid tori, matches two trivial arcs, and obtains dual (1,1) tunnels.
